# Data 

## Hart aber Fair


```{r}
# Subdictionary
project_dir <- here::here("data_transcripts")
```


```{r data-import}
transcripts_haf_v1 <- list(
    raw = fs::dir_ls(
        path = "E:/02_leuner/bachelorarbeit_talkshows/data_transcripts/hart_aber_fair_2", 
        glob = "*.txt"
        ) %>%
        # Read the files into the list
        map(~ read_file(.)) %>%
        # Set the list names to the base file names (without the path)
        set_names(~ str_extract(basename(.), "^(.*)(?=\\.txt)"))
)
```


```{r recode-data-transcripts-correct}
transcripts_haf_v1$correct <- transcripts_haf_v1$raw %>% 
    # Import and process each file
    map(~ read_file(.) %>%
            str_split("\n") %>%
            .[[1]] %>%
            tibble(line = .) %>%
            mutate(
                speaker = str_extract(line, "S\\d+"),  # Extract speaker 
                timestamp = str_extract(line, "\\[\\d{2}:\\d{2}:\\d{2}\\]"),  # Extract timestamps
                across(timestamp, ~str_remove_all(., "[\\[\\]]")),  # Remove the brackets from timestamp
                dialogue = str_remove(line, "S\\d+ \\[\\d{2}:\\d{2}:\\d{2}\\]: "),  # Extract dialogue text
                dialogue_length = nchar(dialogue),
            ) %>% 
            filter( # Filter out lines without speaker or dialogue
                !is.na(speaker) &
                !is.na(dialogue)
                ) %>% 
            mutate(
                timestamp = hms::as_hms(timestamp),  # Convert timestamp to hms object
                duration = as.numeric(difftime(lead(timestamp), timestamp, units = "secs"))  # Calculate duration
            )
    ) %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "source") %>% 
    mutate(
        program = case_when(
            str_detect(source, "Lanz") ~ "ZDF",
            str_detect(source, "Illner") ~ "ZDF",
            str_detect(source, "Hart_aber_fair") ~ "Das Erste",
            TRUE ~ "unknown"
        ), 
        moderator = case_when(
            str_detect(source, "Lanz")  ~ "Lanz",
            str_detect(source, "Illner") ~ "Illner",
            str_detect(source, "Hart_aber_fair") ~ "hart_aber_fair",
            TRUE ~ "unknown"
        ),
        id_moderator = case_when(
            moderator == "Lanz" ~ 1,
            moderator == "Illner" ~ 2,
            moderator == "hart_aber_fair" ~ 3,
            TRUE ~ 0
        ),
        prefix = paste0(
            ifelse(program == "ZDF", "ZDF", "ARD"),
            id_moderator, "_"
        ),
        id_moderator = paste0(prefix, tolower(moderator))
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        program_prefix = case_when(
            program == "ZDF" ~ "Z",
            program == "Das Erste" ~ "A",
            TRUE ~ "U"
        ),
        moderator_prefix = case_when(
            moderator == "Lanz" ~ "l",
            moderator == "Illner" ~ "i",
            moderator == "hart_aber_fair" ~ "haf",
            TRUE ~ "u"
        ),
        id_speaker = paste0(program_prefix, moderator_prefix, source, "_", speaker)
    ) %>%
    select(-line, -prefix, -program_prefix, -moderator_prefix)

# drop unnecessary lines
transcripts_haf_v1<- transcripts_haf_v1$correct %>%
  select( -id_speaker) 

# Show_id
make_show_id <- function(source) {
  # delate "Hart_aber_fair_"
  datum <- sub("Hart_aber_fair_", "", source)
  # interpret as date (Format: Jahr.Monat.Tag, z.B. 2024.09.02)
  datum_date <- as.Date(datum, "%Y.%m.%d")
  # build show_id 
  paste0("haf_", format(datum_date, "%Y%m%d"))
}

transcripts_haf_v1$show_id <- make_show_id(transcripts_haf_v1$source)



# ceate dialogue_id

transcripts_haf_v1 <- transcripts_haf_v1 %>%
  group_by(show_id) %>%
  mutate(dialogue_id = sprintf("%s_d_%03d", show_id, row_number())) %>%
  ungroup()


# sort date
transcripts_haf_v1 <- transcripts_haf_v1 %>%
  mutate(
    date_str = str_extract(source, "\\d{4}\\.\\d{2}\\.\\d{2}"),
    date = as.Date(date_str, "%Y.%m.%d")
  ) %>%
  arrange(date)

```


```{r}
write.csv(transcripts_haf_v1, "transcripts_haf_v1.csv", row.names=FALSE)
```

### Load both datasets
```{r}
# Data Shows
library(readr)
transcripts_haf_v1 <- read_csv("transcripts_haf_v1.csv")

# Data Excel Speaker information
speaker_infos <-  readxl::read_excel("speaker_identification.xlsx")
```

### Join Datasets: Speaker + Transkripte

```{r}
# Data Shows
library(readr)
haf_speaker<- read_csv("haf_speaker.csv")


# Data Excel Speaker infos
speaker_infos <-  readxl::read_excel("speaker_identification.xlsx")

```


```{r}

haf_dataframe <- haf_speaker %>%
  left_join(speaker_infos, by = "speaker_id")

write.csv(haf_dataframe , "haf_dataframe.csv", row.names=FALSE)
```



## Illner


```{r}
# Name of subdirectory
project_dir <- here::here("data_transcripts")
```

```{r data-import}
transcripts_illner_v1 <- list(
    raw = fs::dir_ls(
        path = here(project_dir, "illner"), 
        glob = "*.txt"
        ) %>%
        # Read the files into the list
        map(~ read_file(.)) %>%
        # Set the list names to the base file names (without the path)
        set_names(~ str_extract(basename(.), "^(.*)(?=\\.txt)"))
)
```


```{r recode-data-transcripts-correct}
transcripts_illner_v1$correct <- transcripts_illner_v1$raw %>% 
    # Import and process each file
    map(~ read_file(.) %>%
            str_split("\n") %>%
            .[[1]] %>%
            tibble(line = .) %>%
            mutate(
                speaker = str_extract(line, "S\\d+"),  # Extract speaker 
                timestamp = str_extract(line, "\\[\\d{2}:\\d{2}:\\d{2}\\]"),  # Extract timestamps
                across(timestamp, ~str_remove_all(., "[\\[\\]]")),  # Remove the brackets from timestamp
                dialogue = str_remove(line, "S\\d+ \\[\\d{2}:\\d{2}:\\d{2}\\]: "),  # Extract dialogue text
                dialogue_length = nchar(dialogue),
            ) %>% 
            filter( # Filter out lines without speaker or dialogue
                !is.na(speaker) &
                !is.na(dialogue)
                ) %>% 
            mutate(
                timestamp = hms::as_hms(timestamp),  # Convert timestamp to hms object
                duration = as.numeric(difftime(lead(timestamp), timestamp, units = "secs"))  # Calculate duration
            )
    ) %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "source") %>% 
    mutate(
        program = case_when(
            str_detect(source, "Lanz") ~ "ZDF",
            str_detect(source, "Illner") ~ "ZDF",
            str_detect(source, "Hart_aber_fair") ~ "Das Erste",
            TRUE ~ "unknown"
        ), 
        moderator = case_when(
            str_detect(source, "Lanz")  ~ "Lanz",
            str_detect(source, "Illner") ~ "Illner",
            str_detect(source, "Hart_aber_fair") ~ "hart_aber_fair",
            TRUE ~ "unknown"
        ),
        id_moderator = case_when(
            moderator == "Lanz" ~ 1,
            moderator == "Illner" ~ 2,
            moderator == "hart_aber_fair" ~ 3,
            TRUE ~ 0
        ),
        prefix = paste0(
            ifelse(program == "ZDF", "ZDF", "ARD"),
            id_moderator, "_"
        ),
        id_moderator = paste0(prefix, tolower(moderator))
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        program_prefix = case_when(
            program == "ZDF" ~ "Z",
            program == "Das Erste" ~ "A",
            TRUE ~ "U"
        ),
        moderator_prefix = case_when(
            moderator == "Lanz" ~ "l",
            moderator == "Illner" ~ "i",
            moderator == "hart_aber_fair" ~ "haf",
            TRUE ~ "u"
        ),
        id_speaker = paste0(program_prefix, moderator_prefix, source, "_", speaker)
    ) %>%
    select(-line, -prefix, -program_prefix, -moderator_prefix)



## sort date
transcripts_illner_v1$correct <- transcripts_illner_v1$correct %>%
  mutate(
    date_str = str_extract(source, "\\d{2}\\.\\d{2}\\.\\d{2}"),
    date = dmy(date_str)
  ) %>%
  arrange(date)


## drop unnecessary lines
transcripts_illner_v1<- transcripts_illner_v1$correct %>%
  select( -id_speaker)

# create show id
make_show_id <- function(source) {
  # delete "Illner_"
  datum <- sub("Illner_", "", source)
  # delete Punkte (.)
  datum <- gsub("\\.", "", datum)
  # interprete date
  paste0("illner_", format(as.Date(datum, "%d%m%y"), "%Y%m%d"))
}


transcripts_illner_v1$show_id <- make_show_id(transcripts_illner_v1$source)



## create dialogue_id

transcripts_illner_v1 <- transcripts_illner_v1 %>%
  group_by(show_id) %>%
  mutate(dialogue_id = sprintf("%s_d_%03d", show_id, row_number())) %>%
  ungroup()

# filter Sondersendungen
transcripts_illner_v1 <- transcripts_illner_v1 %>%
  filter(!source %in% c("Illner_24.10.24_S", "Illner_28.11.24_S", "Illner_06.06.24"))
  


write.csv(transcripts_illner_v1, "transcripts_illner_v1.csv", row.names=FALSE)
```

```{r data-import}
transcripts_lanz_v1 <- list(
    raw = fs::dir_ls(
        path = "E:/02_leuner/bachelorarbeit_talkshows/data_transcripts/lanz/lanz_do", 
        glob = "*.txt"
        ) %>%
        # Read the files into the list
        map(~ read_file(.)) %>%
        # Set the list names to the base file names (without the path)
        set_names(~ str_extract(basename(.), "^(.*)(?=\\.txt)"))
)
```


```{r recode-data-transcripts-correct}
transcripts_lanz_v1$correct <- transcripts_lanz_v1$raw %>% 
    # Import and process each file
    map(~ read_file(.) %>%
            str_split("\n") %>%
            .[[1]] %>%
            tibble(line = .) %>%
            mutate(
                speaker = str_extract(line, "S\\d+"),  # Extract speaker 
                timestamp = str_extract(line, "\\[\\d{2}:\\d{2}:\\d{2}\\]"),  # Extract timestamps
                across(timestamp, ~str_remove_all(., "[\\[\\]]")),  # Remove the brackets from timestamp
                dialogue = str_remove(line, "S\\d+ \\[\\d{2}:\\d{2}:\\d{2}\\]: "),  # Extract dialogue text
                dialogue_length = nchar(dialogue),
            ) %>% 
            filter( # Filter out lines without speaker or dialogue
                !is.na(speaker) &
                !is.na(dialogue)
                ) %>% 
            mutate(
                timestamp = hms::as_hms(timestamp),  # Convert timestamp to hms object
                duration = as.numeric(difftime(lead(timestamp), timestamp, units = "secs"))  # Calculate duration
            )
    ) %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "source") %>% 
    mutate(
        program = case_when(
            str_detect(source, "Lanz") ~ "ZDF",
            str_detect(source, "Illner") ~ "ZDF",
            str_detect(source, "Hart_aber_fair") ~ "Das Erste",
            TRUE ~ "unknown"
        ), 
        moderator = case_when(
            str_detect(source, "Lanz")  ~ "Lanz",
            str_detect(source, "Illner") ~ "Illner",
            str_detect(source, "Hart_aber_fair") ~ "hart_aber_fair",
            TRUE ~ "unknown"
        ),
        id_moderator = case_when(
            moderator == "Lanz" ~ 1,
            moderator == "Illner" ~ 2,
            moderator == "hart_aber_fair" ~ 3,
            TRUE ~ 0
        ),
        prefix = paste0(
            ifelse(program == "ZDF", "ZDF", "ARD"),
            id_moderator, "_"
        ),
        id_moderator = paste0(prefix, tolower(moderator))
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        program_prefix = case_when(
            program == "ZDF" ~ "Z",
            program == "Das Erste" ~ "A",
            TRUE ~ "U"
        ),
        moderator_prefix = case_when(
            moderator == "Lanz" ~ "l",
            moderator == "Illner" ~ "i",
            moderator == "hart_aber_fair" ~ "haf",
            TRUE ~ "u"
        ),
        id_speaker = paste0(program_prefix, moderator_prefix, source, "_", speaker)
    ) %>%
    select(-line, -prefix, -program_prefix, -moderator_prefix)





## drop unnecessary lines
transcripts_lanz_v1<- transcripts_lanz_v1$correct %>%
  select( -id_speaker)

# create Show_id 
make_show_id <- function(source) {
  # delete "Lanz_"
  datum <- sub("Lanz_", "", source)
  # interpret date (Format: Jahr.Monat.Tag)
  datum_date <- as.Date(datum, "%Y.%m.%d")
  # build show_id 
  paste0("lanz_", format(datum_date, "%Y%m%d"))
}

transcripts_lanz_v1$show_id <- make_show_id(transcripts_lanz_v1$source)



# create dialogue_id

transcripts_lanz_v1 <- transcripts_lanz_v1 %>%
  group_by(show_id) %>%
  mutate(dialogue_id = sprintf("%s_d_%03d", show_id, row_number())) %>%
  ungroup()


## sort date
transcripts_lanz_v1 <- transcripts_lanz_v1 %>%
  mutate(
    date_str = str_extract(source, "\\d{4}\\.\\d{2}\\.\\d{2}"),
    date = as.Date(date_str, "%Y.%m.%d")
  ) %>%
  arrange(date)



write.csv(transcripts_lanz_v1, "transcripts_lanz_v1.csv", row.names=FALSE)
```

### Join Datasets

```{r}
# Data Shows
library(readr)
lanz_speaker<- read_csv("lanz_speaker.csv")


# Data Excel Speaker infos
speaker_infos <-  readxl::read_excel("speaker_identification.xlsx")

```


```{r}
# Join Datasets:
lanz_dataframe <- lanz_speaker %>%
  left_join(speaker_infos, by = "speaker_id")


write.csv(lanz_dataframe , "lanz_dataframe.csv", row.names=FALSE)
```
